sentences.text: Two conditions, neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 3 and retinitis pigmentosa 101, are both recorded as caused by the gene CLN3 [e_2a2eaf172436] [e_66fafb6711d9].
Both gene links are curated, meaning they come from OMIM [e_2a2eaf172436] [e_66fafb6711d9].
Constellate computed that the two conditions share this causal gene, at confidence 0.9 [e_e5bde56ef996].
That shared-gene link is inferred, meaning it was calculated from the two curated links and is not a separate database finding [e_e5bde56ef996].

For neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 3, two observed features are recorded in OMIM, a fingerprint-shaped build-up of storage material in cells and vacuolated white blood cells, each from a single report [e_290723a095b7] [e_4b6cd0fc52ba].
These edges do not show how the same gene leads to two different conditions [e_e5bde56ef996].
They also record no symptoms for retinitis pigmentosa 101 and no studies or treatments for either condition [e_66fafb6711d9].
